status: provisional scene pacing for listening review; not a shot plan

scenes.title: A familiar stranger
beats: The wreck rests in the breach. Harper and Taffy approach the exposed entrance.
The beaked statue recalls the Scrapper at the spaceport. Their flashlight wakes a line of lights.
scenes.turn: Someone they thought unique belongs to something much larger.
scenes.lyricLink: Instrumental opening; retain the two original motion shots.

scenes.title: The world beneath
beats: A few tentative steps reveal towers receding into a vast dark cavern.
Three civic statues overlook a central destination. The pair pause; the flashlight remains necessary.
scenes.lyricLink: Instrumental opening; approved Image 16 is the visual anchor.

scenes.title: The entrance disappears
beats: Establish the wreck and jagged breach from outside BEFORE the illusion begins.
Inside, the pair exchange a look. Intercut the same exterior as a rock disguise flickers into place.
Outside light pulses across their faces, then vanishes. Their flashlight stays on.
scenes.turn: The audience learns what concealment looks like.
scenes.lyricLink: Been stuck behind the picture / still here on the moon.
openDetails: Exact exterior geometry and effect must be established from one reference.
Concealment is optical; do not imply solid rock physically materializes.

scenes.title: No obvious way back
beats: They turn toward the lost light, searching the apparent rock and shadow.
Taffy sweeps the flashlight across the nearby routes. A faint line of area lights leads farther down.
They choose the visible path, keeping close together.
scenes.turn: Curiosity becomes a search for a way out.
scenes.lyricLink: Repeated stuck / never free to leave imagery.
openDetails: They need not test or explain whether the illusion is passable.

scenes.title: The deserted descent
beats: They descend through empty-looking passages between immense structures.
At an interrupted walkway, Taffy finds a lower crossing with the flashlight.
Harper helps him across; he lights her footing as she follows. They emerge deeper inside.
scenes.turn: They solve one physical obstacle together before meeting anyone.
scenes.lyricLink: Not a sound / hallway down below / hidden from memory.
openDetails: Interrupted walkway is a provisional obstacle; replace if another fits the geography better.

scenes.title: A hidden living society
beats: From cover, they glimpse inhabitants working among the towers. These are the Scrapper's people.
A watchkeeper sees a distant searching craft through a viewing aperture.
The inhabitants dim exposed lights and check the rock disguise. Work resumes only when the search passes.
scenes.turn: Show that being unseen is deliberate, shared behavior.
scenes.lyricLink: Open up / hide out from the outside / things faster than we go.
openDetails: Searching craft is a proposed recurring visual cue; it need not see the city.

scenes.title: Discovered and cornered
beats: A worker notices the strangers. Harper and Taffy retreat through a narrow service route.
Guards cut off the next turn. The pair stop rather than fight.
An escort takes them past shuttered work areas; one inhabitant watches them with uncertainty.
scenes.turn: The city is alive, but the visitors are treated as a threat.
scenes.lyricLink: Still here / wait for wishes, then the instrumental space.
openDetails: Observer may become the helper; identity remains open.

scenes.title: A place for everyone except them
beats: They are brought before one or more living representatives associated with the three statues.
Harper points upward, asking to leave. A representative indicates the concealed world and refuses.
Guards escort them away. The watching inhabitant notices their disappointment.
scenes.turn: Their wish to leave conflicts with the society's need for secrecy.
scenes.lyricLink: Story of the family / all for one / every part has a role.
openDetails: No dialogue or explanatory writing. Which leaders appear is undecided.
A missing leader is optional and not required in this pass.

scenes.title: Held among the quiet machinery
beats: A barrier closes around a holding area beside old service equipment.
Harper studies the exits. Taffy follows a pulse of light along a conduit within reach.
Through a viewing opening, they can still see the concealed breach area.
scenes.turn: Physical captivity is clear; Taffy notices a possible opportunity.
scenes.lyricLink: Every piece on the shelf / keeping quiet to itself.
openDetails: Holding-area geometry and credible access to the equipment need design.

scenes.title: A control they recognize
beats: Taffy finds an exposed control and draws Harper's attention to it.
A small test makes the familiar rock disguise shimmer; releasing it restores concealment.
Both recognize the connection. A further movement could expose the route to the outside.
scenes.turn: Repeat the opening's visual rule so the control needs no words.
scenes.lyricLink: Open up the secret room, now an apparent opportunity.
openDetails: A reversible test is proposed; it must not accidentally alert everyone.

scenes.title: Their chance to be seen
beats: A distant searchlight crosses the outside view, recalling the earlier searching craft.
Harper reaches toward the control. Taffy readies their flashlight to signal.
Her attention shifts from the outside to the occupied city: opening the disguise would expose everyone.
scenes.turn: Make both the escape opportunity and its cost visible before the choice.
scenes.lyricLink: Still here / waiting for wishes; allow the repeated tail room.
openDetails: Exact sightlines and how outside rescue could free them are unresolved.

scenes.title: They choose the darkness
beats: Hold on Harper's hand near the control, then on the people who would be exposed.
She lets the control go. Taffy lowers the flashlight; they acknowledge the choice together.
They step away. Concealment holds and the searching light passes without seeing them.
scenes.turn: They surrender an apparent escape without knowing anyone is watching.
scenes.lyricLink: Easy staying out of sight / let the dark hold down the light.

scenes.title: An unseen witness decides
beats: Reveal one inhabitant watching through a sightline or viewing device.
They have seen the offered chance and the deliberate refusal. Harper and Taffy remain unaware.
The witness looks toward the guarded holding area, then leaves to act.
scenes.turn: Private trust forms; the wider authorities do not change their decision.
scenes.lyricLink: I gotta sign off: a private decision and a break from official duty.
openDetails: Direct sightline or camera is undecided. Avoid explaining with interface text.

scenes.title: A door opens quietly
beats: The witness returns alone and releases the holding barrier.
They gesture for silence and guide the pair into a service passage.
The three pause as a patrol passes, then hurry toward a concealed launch chamber.
scenes.turn: Someone risks disobedience to help them leave.
scenes.lyricLink: Make your ways away / great escape / come on through.

scenes.title: The helper's cost
beats: The helper reveals a small escape pod. Harper and Taffy recognize a way off-world.
Taffy climbs in while Harper looks back at their guide.
The guide deliberately authorizes launch with a recognizable personal token, leaving a visible record.
scenes.turn: The helper accepts a traceable risk rather than abandon the pair.
scenes.lyricLink: Hide out from the outside / things faster than we go.
openDetails: Personal token and visible record are a proposal; establish the token earlier if retained.
Launch disguise, helper identity and punishment are not fixed.

scenes.title: Up through the hidden world
beats: The helper stays at the controls as the pod closes around Harper and Taffy.
Launch carries them up a dark shaft, past the last amber lights.
They break into the sky through a concealed outlet; the city remains hidden below.
scenes.turn: Their larger goal is finally achieved: leaving the world.
scenes.lyricLink: Make your ways away / make a great escape.
openDetails: Volcanic plume or another disguised outlet remains a choice for later design.

scenes.title: Someone stays behind
beats: Back below, a launch indicator draws attention. The helper stands beside the used control.
Other inhabitants approach; the helper does not attempt to deny the choice.
Cut to Harper and Taffy inside the pod, looking down at the world they have left.
scenes.turn: Freedom has a cost to the person who made it possible.
scenes.lyricLink: Stuck behind the picture / staring at the room now belongs to the helper.
openDetails: Show possible consequences without inventing a punishment or a new rescue subplot.

scenes.title: Orbit and a kept promise
beats: The pod rises into orbit. Harper and Taffy exchange a quieter look of relief.
Below, an ordinary dark landscape gives away nothing of the hidden civilization.
Hold the new horizon long enough for the escape to settle.
scenes.turn: They have left the world while keeping its secret.
scenes.lyricLink: Final sign off / open up the secret room and the musical tail.
